description: Regression baseline after thermo-nuclear refactor: release gates live in src/manuscript/output_gates/ and registry_facts.py (counted in src/ coverage). Refreshed by `uv run python scripts/regression_gate.py --update-baseline` on green runs.

coverage_percent_min_evidence.comment: The environment this floor was measured in was not recorded when the baseline was captured (round-6-thermo-nuclear, 2026-05-23). Re-measured 2026-11-01 with `pytest tests/ --cov=src --cov-fail-under=95`: 95.35% with the pymdp `sim` group installed (commit 9633185, `uv sync --group sim --group viz`), 88.39% without it (commit d88c6f6, 173 tests skipped because the pymdp-gated modules are unimportable). The recorded 95.22 therefore does not reproduce in either environment today; tolerance.coverage_drop_pct_max (1.0 point) absorbs the gap. Re-baselining is a deliberate maintainer decision, not a drive-by edit.

tolerance.comment: Drift bounds applied between the previous green baseline and the current run. Test count may decrease by at most `test_count_drop_max`; coverage by at most `coverage_drop_pct_max` percentage points; invariant count and Lean budgets are absolute floors / ceilings (not tolerances).
